findings.title: Materials' 61-point lens gap signals earnings cliff
findings.body: Materials sits at the 94th percentile on trailing earnings but only the 33rd on forward estimates, the widest split in the table. The market is pricing a 133 percent earnings surge that would have to materialize within twelve months to justify the gap.

findings.title: Consumer Staples' forward percentile collapses despite stable multiple
findings.body: Consumer Staples' forward percentile fell 32 points in a month to the 19th, yet its forward P/E of 19.31 is only modestly below typical levels. The percentile drop is mostly a shift in the sector's own historical distribution, not a dramatic change in the multiple itself.
